purpose: Teach: そぐわない/優劣/ケープ/コロニー/歌人/死人/ビジネスチャンス/スンニ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、伝統に「そぐわない」改革の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the sociology of reforms that don't align with tradition, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Teacher-to-student, slightly curious. Gentle confirmation rather than interrogation. Even pace, calm presence.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、教育評価で優劣を付ける弊害の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I researched the harmful effects of ranking and grading in education.
lines.style: Direct, respectful response. Clear and focused. Small pause after the affirmation, then steady into the substance. Not defensive, just precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 南アフリカのケープタウン、つまりケープ植民史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered colonial history in Cape Town, South Africa, in your paper as well?
lines.style: Reflective, moving through a mental list. Warm interest. Slight lift at the end — checking in with Sakura. Not rushing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦前の植民地、つまりコロニーの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined colonial territories from before the war — the history of colonialism during that period.
lines.style: Steady, informative. Sakura speaking with quiet confidence about her work. No hesitation. Respectful but not overly formal.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 現代歌人の作品研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also researched contemporary poets in your paper?
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently probing. Teacher's warmth with genuine curiosity. Slight wonder in the delivery — connecting different threads. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、刑法における死人、つまり死人の名誉毀損の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked into defamation law regarding the deceased — specifically the protection of the dead person's honor in legal terms.
lines.style: Composed, articulate. Sakura unflinching about an unusual subject. Matter-of-fact but not cold. Pride in having tackled something nuanced.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新興市場のビジネスチャンスの研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And emerging markets were part of your research as well?
lines.style: Gentle continuation. Teacher's steady voice. Moving through the list with care. Warm interest maintained. No rush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中東のスンニ派、つまりスンニ系コミュニティの研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I researched the Sunni communities in the Middle East and the business opportunities within those networks.
lines.style: Clear, assured conclusion. Sakura finishing with precision. Slightly more settled here — the final piece clicking into place. Calm completion.
